title: Middle Eastern Baba Ganoush Stuffed Pork Tenderloin
description: A unique fusion of Middle Eastern flavors with a tender and juicy pork tenderloin, stuffed with a creamy baba ganoush.
instructions: Season the pork tenderloin with salt and black pepper.
Spoon the baba ganoush into the center of the pork tenderloin, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Fold the edges of the pork tenderloin over the baba ganoush, then roll the tenderloin into a tight cylinder.
Place the pork tenderloin on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Drizzle the olive oil over the pork tenderloin, then sprinkle with minced garlic.
Bake the pork tenderloin for 20-25 minutes, or until it reaches an internal temperature of 145°F (63°C).
Transfer the pork tenderloin to a cutting board and let it rest for 5 minutes before slicing.
Garnish with fresh parsley before serving.
